text: `(*Command).ExecuteC` initializes a background context if needed, redirects execution from a child to its root, invokes the Windows pre-execution hook, initializes default help/completion commands, checks command groups, and uses configured args or `os.Args[1:]` by default (`command.go:1051-1082`). It returns the selected `*Command` and an error; `Execute` discards the command and returns only the error (`command.go:1035-1041`).
